Let \(b_n=a_n-1\). Then
\[
b_{n+1}=-\frac13 b_n,\qquad b_1=8,
\]
so
\[
a_n=1+8\left(-\frac13\right)^{n-1}.
\]
Thus
\[
S_n=\sum_{k=1}^n \left[1+8\left(-\frac13\right)^{k-1}\right]
= n+6\left(1-\left(-\frac13\right)^n\right).
\]
Therefore
\[
\left|S_n-n-6\right|=\left|-6\left(-\frac13\right)^n\right|=\frac{6}{3^n}.
\]
We need
\[
\frac{6}{3^n}<\frac1{125}
\iff 3^n>750.
\]
Since \(3^6=729<750\) and \(3^7=2187>750\), the smallest integer is \(n=7\).

\[
\boxed{7}
\]
